text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe I'm failing five subjects!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Now I've got three hours of extra classes
every
day...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Things are looking desperate! Not only
will I have
to stop being an Umadol, but
I might even get
held back!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон's cry for help really hits
home, but
unfortunately, there's nothing
I can do...
